description: Daxuen was founded by three individuals who crossed paths in a region full of discrimination, terrorism, and racism. Upon enduring this lifestyle for many years, they were able to move to the USA hoping to find true meaning in life. And there was the idea of Daxuen. An aesthetic-wear street style that will hopefully paint the world in many beautiful colors with no room for hate or any kind of favoritism toward a distinct population.
